Plan: support other Ettus USRPs (issue #11)¶

Status: implemented (2026-10-20) on 11-usrp-models. Not yet run on a network USRP. The user pages are in Live devices and Signal generator.

1. Goal¶

From the issue: expand the USRP support from the B200 / B205mini to other products, for example the N310, X310 and X410.

2. Starting point¶

The USRP backend (src/device/sdr_uhd.cpp) used the UHD C API, so most calls already worked for any USRP. These parts were written for the B2xx:

Area

B2xx assumption

Device search

uhd_usrp_find("type=b200"): USB B2xx only. The default arguments were type=b200

Channel

Always channel 0

Antennas

The UI offered RX2 and TX/RX. The transmitter always used TX/RX

Rate check

A fixed limit of 61.44 MS/s, and a USB 3 warning above 8 MS/s

Full duplex

RX and TX must have the same rate (true only for the B2xx)

Messages

“B200/B205: 70 MHz - 6 GHz” in tune errors; USB 3 advice for overflows

Tooltips

B2xx rates, gains and bandwidths

Sample ring

256 MB at most (0.3 s at 200 MS/s)

3. Decisions¶

Question

Decision

Why

Model table or device queries

Query the device: antennas, channels, clock sources, and the frequency, rate, gain and bandwidth ranges of the channel

No table to keep up to date. Daughterboards change the X310’s limits

Device search

uhd_usrp_find("") (USB and network) on a background thread in the window. --list-devices stays synchronous

A network search takes about 0.5 s; the UI must not stop

List entries

Network devices by addr=, USB devices by serial=

An address opens without a new broadcast search

Default arguments

Empty: the first USRP UHD finds

type=b200 excluded every other model

Channels

One channel at a time, selected by index (--usrp-channel N, a UI field)

Multi-channel streams need a different data path (one ring per channel)

Subdevice specification

Not exposed. The channel index uses the default specification

The default covers the normal set-ups. It can be added later

Reference

One setting for the clock and time source (--ref internal|external|gpsdo). A missing time source is a warning only

The reference belongs to the device, so RX and TX share it

Rate limit before open

500 MS/s (the X410). A warning above 100 MS/s. The device coerces the rate when it opens

The model is not known before the device opens

Coerced rates

A note in the status bar. For network USRPs, the note names master_clock_rate=

Network USRPs divide a fixed master clock

Full duplex rate rule

Only on the B2xx (one clock for RX and TX)

Other USRPs allow a different rate in each direction

Transmit antenna

Empty means the first transmit antenna of the channel

TX/RX is not a port on the X410 (TX/RX0)

Option name

--usrp-channel, not --channel

--chan is the channel filter

UHD calls on two threads

A lock around uhd_usrp_find and uhd_usrp_make

The background search and an open can overlap

Sample ring

2 s, from 16 MB to 1 GB

High rates need a larger buffer for the recorder

4. Implementation notes¶

  • DeviceCaps (src/device/sdr_device.h) carries what an open device supports. SdrDevice::caps() returns it; the USRP backend fills it after it opens. The window keeps the last value for its antenna and reference lists, the channel count, and the rate and bandwidth tooltips.

  • uhdDeviceInfo() and parseDeviceArgs() are in src/device/sdr_device.cpp, without UHD, so tools/device_check tests them with search strings from each model family.

  • Usrp::usb comes from the motherboard name (B2…). It selects the B2xx rate rule and the USB or network advice for overflows and underflows.

  • The transmitter reports its antenna (SdrTx::antenna()), and the transmit status shows it.

5. Verification¶

Check

State

Build without warnings, all self-checks, device_check

Done

No USRP attached: the search shows “USRP (none detected)”, the open error names the USB and network causes

Done (macOS, UHD 4.11)

The USRP options popup: antenna, channel, reference, bandwidth

Done (Xvfb)

A B2xx still receives and transmits as before (default antenna RX2, TX/RX)

To do on hardware

X310 / N310 / X410: search by address, channel 1, external reference, coerced rate note, transmit antenna default

To do on hardware
